title: Hardwood Flooring — Flooring and Surface Finishes
body:

This record belongs to the Flooring and Surface Finishes database and covers hardwood flooring in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers flooring and surface finishes: hardwood, tile, resilient, carpet and system selection.

Actual content. Hardwood Flooring is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed.
